article.title: "A Man's Life Comes In Seasons" -- The Come-Up Dichotomy (Part 4)
article.previewText:
There is a very important distinction to be made re: advice. Every man is two men: who he is TODAY, and who he was on "THE COME-UP." 
These two versions get conflated all the damn time.
